title_en: AI Act: new prohibitions and legacy-system marking duties apply
who_en: Providers of AI systems (including general-purpose AI systems) that generate synthetic audio, image, video or text and were placed on the market before 2 August 2026; providers and deployers regarding the new Article 5 prohibitions
detail_en: The Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force 27 July 2026) kept the 2 August 2026 transparency duties but gave pre-existing generative systems until 2 December 2026 to implement machine-readable marking under Article 50(2). The same date brings the added prohibition on AI used to create non-consensual intimate imagery and child sexual abuse material.
legal_basis: Reg. (EU) 2024/1689 Art. 5(1)(ba)-(bb), Art. 111(4) and Art. 113, third paragraph, point (a), as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744
title_de: KI-Verordnung: neue Verbote und Kennzeichnungspflicht für Bestandssysteme

title_en: CRA: member states to have enough notified bodies in place
who_en: Member states and notifying authorities; manufacturers whose products need third-party conformity assessment (e.g. important products of Class II)
detail_en: Member states shall strive to ensure, by 11 December 2026, that there are enough notified bodies in the EU to carry out CRA conformity assessments and avoid bottlenecks before the CRA applies in full on 11 December 2027. A best-efforts target, not a hard obligation on companies.
title_de: CRA: Mitgliedstaaten sollen ausreichend notifizierte Stellen bereitstellen

title_en: eIDAS 2: every member state to offer an EU Digital Identity Wallet
who_en: Member states (wallet issuance); relying parties preparing wallet acceptance
detail_en: Article 5a(1) requires each member state to provide at least one wallet within 24 months of the entry into force of the implementing acts under Articles 5a(23) and 5c(6). Those acts were adopted on 28 November 2024, published on 4 December 2024 and entered into force on 24 December 2024, which puts the deadline at 24 December 2026. Acceptance obligations for private relying parties in regulated sectors follow twelve months later.
title_de: eIDAS 2: jeder Mitgliedstaat muss eine EUDI-Wallet anbieten

who_en: Essential and important entities in Austria
detail_en: Section 29(3) NISG 2026 requires registration within three months of entry into force (1 October 2026). The Federal Office for Cybersecurity (Bundesamt für Cybersicherheit) gives the deadline as 1 January 2027, which shifts to 4 January 2027 at the latest because the period ends on a public holiday (section 33(2) AVG). Entities that come into scope later register within three months of meeting the criteria.

title_en: NIS2: member states review their lists of essential and important entities
who_en: National competent authorities; entities whose classification may change
detail_en: The lists were due by 17 April 2025 and are to be reviewed and, where appropriate, updated at least every two years. Entities that crossed a size threshold or changed sector since 2025 are the typical candidates for re-classification.
title_de: NIS2: Mitgliedstaaten überprüfen ihre Listen wesentlicher und wichtiger Einrichtungen

title_en: AI Act: general-purpose AI models placed on the market before August 2025 must comply
who_en: Providers of general-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025
detail_en: GPAI obligations have applied to new models since 2 August 2025; models already on the market before that date get a transition period until 2 August 2027. This date was not changed by the Digital Omnibus on AI.
title_de: KI-Verordnung: vor August 2025 in Verkehr gebrachte KI-Modelle mit allgemeinem Verwendungszweck müssen konform sein

title_en: NIS2: first Commission review of the Directive
who_en: European Commission (report to Parliament and Council); all in-scope sectors indirectly
detail_en: The Commission reviews the functioning of NIS2 by 17 October 2027 and every 36 months thereafter, assessing in particular whether entity size and the sectors in Annexes I and II remain relevant. The report may be accompanied by a legislative proposal; separately, the Commission already proposed targeted NIS2 amendments on 20 January 2026.
title_de: NIS2: erste Überprüfung der Richtlinie durch die Kommission

title_en: AI Act: high-risk obligations for stand-alone Annex III systems apply
who_en: Providers and deployers of Annex III high-risk AI (e.g. HR screening, credit scoring, critical-infrastructure safety components)
detail_en: Originally 2 August 2026; postponed by the Digital Omnibus on AI to 2 December 2027 as a fixed calendar date, not a standards-dependent trigger.
legal_basis: Reg. (EU) 2024/1689 Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c)(i), as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744
title_de: KI-Verordnung: Hochrisiko-Pflichten für eigenständige Anhang-III-Systeme gelten

title_en: CRA applies in full: essential requirements, conformity assessment, CE marking
who_en: Manufacturers, importers and distributors of products with digital elements
detail_en: Products placed on the market from this date need to meet the Annex I essential cybersecurity requirements, carry technical documentation and a conformity assessment, and provide security updates for the support period.
title_de: CRA gilt vollständig: grundlegende Anforderungen, Konformitätsbewertung, CE-Kennzeichnung

title_en: eIDAS 2: wallet acceptance duty reaches private relying parties
who_en: Private relying parties (except micro and small enterprises) required by EU or national law, or by contract, to use strong user authentication for online identification, e.g. in transport, energy, banking and financial services, social security, health, drinking water, postal services, digital infrastructure, education or telecommunications
detail_en: No later than 36 months after the implementing acts entered into force (24 December 2024), i.e. twelve months after the wallet-availability deadline, these private services must accept the EU Digital Identity Wallet for identification where strong authentication is required, upon the user's voluntary request.
title_de: eIDAS 2: Wallet-Akzeptanzpflicht erreicht private vertrauende Parteien

title_en: DORA: Commission review, including the critical ICT third-party provider regime
who_en: European Commission (after consulting the ESAs and ESRB); financial entities and critical ICT third-party service providers indirectly
detail_en: By 17 January 2028 the Commission reviews DORA and reports to Parliament and Council, where appropriate with a legislative proposal. The review covers at least the criteria for designating critical ICT third-party providers, the voluntary notification of significant cyber threats, and oversight of critical providers established in third countries.
title_de: DORA: Überprüfung durch die Kommission, einschließlich des Regimes für kritische IKT-Drittdienstleister

title_en: AI Act: high-risk obligations for AI embedded in Annex I regulated products apply
who_en: Providers of AI systems that are safety components of, or are themselves, products under the Annex I Section A legislation (e.g. medical and in vitro diagnostic devices, toys, lifts, radio equipment, pressure equipment, personal protective equipment)
detail_en: Originally 2 August 2027; postponed by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 to 2 August 2028. The same regulation moved machinery (Regulation (EU) 2023/1230) to Annex I Section B, so AI in machinery will be regulated through Machinery Regulation delegated acts that apply by 2 August 2028. Vehicles and other Section B products were never subject to these Chapter III obligations directly.
legal_basis: Reg. (EU) 2024/1689 Art. 113, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744
title_de: KI-Verordnung: Hochrisiko-Pflichten für KI in Anhang-I-Produkten gelten

title_en: CER: resilience obligations start 10 months after an entity is notified
who_en: Entities identified as critical entities by their member state (identification was due by 17 July 2026, notification within one month)
detail_en: Chapter III duties (resilience measures, incident notification, background checks) apply from 10 months after the date of the notification; the critical-entity risk assessment itself is due within nine months of receiving the notification (Art. 12(1)). An entity notified in August 2026 therefore faces its risk-assessment deadline around May 2027 and the remaining obligations around June 2027. Critical entities in banking, financial market infrastructure and digital infrastructure have no Chapter III obligations unless national law provides otherwise.
title_de: CER: Resilienzpflichten beginnen 10 Monate nach Benachrichtigung

title_en: Germany: KRITIS-Dachgesetz registration, then risk analysis and resilience plan
who_en: Operators of critical installations (physical resilience, CER transposition)
detail_en: Adopted by the Bundestag on 29 January 2026, approved by the Bundesrat on 6 March 2026, in force since 17 March 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I No. 66). Operators register on the joint BBK/BSI platform no later than three months after a facility counts as a critical installation under the thresholds and cut-off dates set by the Federal Interior Ministry's ordinance (section 5(1)). The original fixed date of 17 July 2026 was removed by an amendment of 21 July 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I No. 221). The risk analysis applies nine months after registration; resilience measures and plan, incident reporting and management duties apply ten months after registration.
title_de: Deutschland: Registrierung nach KRITIS-Dachgesetz, danach Risikoanalyse und Resilienzplan

title_en: Germany: evidence of security measures by operators of critical installations
who_en: Operators of critical installations under the BSIG (KRITIS operators)
detail_en: Operators of critical installations demonstrate compliance with their security obligations to the BSI through audits, tests or certification every three years. The BSI sets the date of the first submission, which is no earlier than three years after the operator first qualifies; for former KRITIS operators, no earlier than three years after their last evidence under the old § 8a(3) BSIG.
title_de: Deutschland: Nachweise der Betreiber kritischer Anlagen
